pages.text: We heard the call and put down our packs. We left a way open for XXX. No one told us to leave. Our bodies touched and our cores said the same words. I counted the slimes beside me. I could still tell how many there were then. — Last Rally Record

Little pieces returned and the great body healed. Broken pieces left empty places. Elsewhere, two slimes joined into one small body. When they parted, they remembered their names. I did not know why XXX had left. — Endless Assembly Record
